Name: Apple Inc
Description: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company that specializes in consumer electronics, computer software and online services. Apple is the world's largest technology company by revenue and one of the world's most valuable companies. It is also the world's fourth-largest PC vendor by unit sales, and fourth-largest smartphone manufacturer. The company's consumer software includes the macOS, iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems, the iTunes media player, the Safari web browser, the Shazam music identifier, and the iLife and iWork creativity and productivity suites. Its online services include the iTunes Store, the iOS App Store, Mac App Store, Apple Music, Apple TV+, iMessage, and iCloud.
